findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in Terraform source. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, deployment tooling, or Lambda environment-variable access, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if valid.

The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security patches. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the Lambda execution environment or dependencies.
